solution.title: Winget & Microsoft Store App Management with Microsoft Intune

products.name: Winget & Microsoft Store App Management with Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Deploy and keep current the apps your users actually ask for — Microsoft Store apps and winget packages — through Intune, with assignments, updates, and Company Portal self-service.
products.description:
Deploy and keep current the apps your users actually ask for — Microsoft Store apps and winget packages — through Intune, with assignments, updates, and Company Portal self-service.

Users want mainstream apps, and IT wants them installed and patched without packaging each one. Intune deploys Microsoft Store apps (the new Store, winget-backed) and, via winget, a large public catalog of Windows apps — with assignment, update, and self-service through Company Portal. This solution stands up Store and winget app management end to end: adding Store apps, using winget for apps beyond the Store, configuring required vs available (self-service) assignments, handling updates, and piloting before fleet rollout — cross-referencing the Enterprise App Catalog (curated prepackaged apps) and the app-deployment-troubleshooting product for failures.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Microsoft Store apps in Intune — add and assign new-Store (winget-backed) apps, required vs available, and Company Portal self-service
  • Winget for the long tail — deploy apps beyond the Store via winget, with detection/update considerations (flagged verify-with-Microsoft)
  • Updates — how Store/winget apps stay current and what you must manage vs what is automatic
  • Assignment strategy — required for baseline apps, available for self-service, uninstall behavior, and pilot rings; name every object
  • Choose the right lane — Store/winget vs Enterprise App Catalog vs custom Win32 (pointer to those products), with reporting on install/update status

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A working Store + winget app-management practice that gets mainstream apps installed, self-serviceable, and patched through Intune — without hand-packaging the apps users ask for every day.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • WINGETSTORE-Discovery.ps1 — inventory the Microsoft Store (new / winget-backed) apps deployed in
    • WINGETSTORE-Report.ps1 — install/update status for Microsoft Store (new) / winget apps, exported to
    • WINGETSTORE-Set-Assignment.ps1 — assign a Microsoft Store (new) / winget app as Required or
    • WINGETSTORE-Test-Install.ps1 — confirm a pilot Store/winget app is installed and detected on the
    • WINGETSTORE-Validate.ps1 — PASS/FAIL check that the pilot Store app + winget app are deployed,

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
